title: Erie
description: The underground is no longer safe… something is lurking in the dark!
body:
The Erie mod brings the terrifying creature from the 2012 indie horror game Erie into the depths of Minecraft. A result of forced experiments, this mutated monster, now roams the underground, moving with terrifying speed and aggression. Not even a shield will protect you from it.
But that’s not all. Hidden within the mod is a special Easter egg referencing the legendary KSI playthrough, a tribute to one of the most iconic horror gaming moments. Will you survive the horrors beneath, or become just another victim of the experiments?

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!

● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where can I find those mobs?

Erie and the Human can be found underground.


</details>



![Erie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3b876690e46b12c4acd2a3156861df4cd5a5e64.png)

Erie is a mutated humanoid monster found underground below Y-level 50. Its presence can be heard from afar. Erie is powerful, durable, and can climb as well as walk up three-block-high obstacles. It moves quickly, relentlessly hunting players and Humans. It can also break shields.
